coverage.summary: Rental units in the City of Los Angeles subject to the RSO: properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28. Units already subject to the RSO are outside AB 1482 (the state just-cause and rent cap law).
coverage.other_conditions:
Covered unit types include:
- apartments
- condominiums and townhomes
- duplexes
- two or more single-family dwellings on the same parcel
- hotel, motel, rooming or boarding house rooms occupied by the same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days
- residential units attached to commercial buildings
- ADUs and JADUs
- mobile homes and RVs in mobile home parks

Replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are also covered.

result.notes:
Corrections made:
- requires_unknown_facts: changed from true to false. The RSO covers ordinary rental buildings identified by a construction date of on or before Oct 1, 1978, which assessor data can check. Temporary and luxury exemptions go in unverifiable_exemptions instead.
- landlord_size_condition: nulled. The Mom & Pop conditions do not limit which buildings the rule covers; they only reduce the relocation amount, and they include landlord conduct (prior use of the provision). This condition is now listed as an unverifiable reduction.
- Old other_conditions (tenant qualified, eligible or low-income status): removed. These are tenant facts that set the payment amount, not building coverage. Replaced with the covered unit types and replacement units listed by LAHD.
- 'Tenant qualified or low-income status': removed from unverifiable_exemptions for the same reason.
- Luxury exemption: added to unverifiable_exemptions.
- Summary: reworded so its claim about the state rule is supported by D040, which lists RSO units as not covered under AB 1482.
- Construction basis: kept as year_built. LAHD says 'first built'; the code's certificate-of-occupancy basis is not in the documents.
